title: Rule ID tags, generated index and lint
item: Rule/scenario IDs as tags in tests, prompt sections, tool and harness code; script that generates the rule → scenarios → tests → source index; lint (every spec rule ID in ≥1 test and ≥1 source location; every ID in code exists in the spec)
motivation: Tags survive file moves, hand-written maps don't (Specification by Example ch. 11); a generated index can't rot, a hand-written feature map does
notes: No hand-written feature map. Depends on item 6 showing the owners.
done_means: Rule IDs are tagged in the tests and source of one example. The index is generated. The lint fails on a seeded missing tag and passes otherwise.
